unpad_input_hidden_states: unpad input hidden states using an attention mask and return flattened tensors with cumulative sequence lengths
pad_input_hidden_states: pad flattened hidden states back to original batch and sequence length dimensions using indices
unpad_input_with_unused_mask: unpad input hidden states combining attention mask and unused mask to include allocated but unused tokens
pad_input_from_indices: pad unmasked hidden states back to (batch, seqlen, ...) shape using precomputed token indices
unpad_input_for_attention: unpad transformer hidden states to remove masked tokens before efficient flash attention computation
